property_summary: After a valid fallback call, if the payout condition is true in the reference contract (block.number % 15 == 0), address(c).balance must be 0, and if it is false, address(c).balance must be 10 ether; the buggy contract inverts this relationship, so the balance rule fails for some input.
change_summary: Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0.
